about: The 16 colours of the ReactOS 0.4.16 kernel boot screen: the palette of the logo bitmap, which the whole screen is shown through. rgb is the 8-bit value stored in the bitmap, with its low two bits clear so it survives the VGA DAC unchanged; dac is the six-bit value the DAC keeps; display is that value expanded back to eight bits the usual way, (dac << 2) | (dac >> 4).
